<!-- Generated by `ims gen docs` from the Makefile. Do not edit: run `make docs-gen`. -->

Shortcuts for the commands you run every day. They only need `go` (and `npm` for the dashboard
and docs site), so they work the same on Windows, macOS and Linux. `make help` prints this list.

| Target | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `make tools` | Install the developer tools used by `dev` and `lint`. |
| `make rename` | Rename the starter to your app: make rename MODULE=github.com/acme/shop-api [NAME=] [BINARY=] [TITLE=] [DRY=1] |
| `make env` | Warn when .env is missing. |
| `make key-generate` | Generate APP_KEY and write it to .env (KEY_FLAGS=--show prints it, --force replaces one). |
| `make build` | Build the release binary with a baked-in version. |
| `make build-all` | Build the developer SPA and the client app, then the Go binary. |
| `make web-build` | Build the developer SPA into web/dev/dist (embedded by Go). |
| `make web-typecheck` | Type-check the developer SPA. |
| `make web-style-check` | Check the SPA design tokens: WCAG AA contrast, type scale, no raw colours. |
| `make dev-web` | Run the SPA dev server on :5173 with /dev/api proxied to :8080. |
| `make app-build` | Build the client app into web/app/dist (embedded by Go, served at /). |
| `make app-typecheck` | Type-check the client app. |
| `make app-style-check` | Check the client app's design tokens: WCAG AA contrast, type scale, no raw colours. |
| `make app-openapi-check` | Fail if the client app's generated API types are stale. |
| `make dev-app` | Run the client app dev server on :8082 with /api proxied to :8081. |
| `make dev` | Run the SPA dev server (:8080, HMR) and the API (:8081, air). |
| `make dev-api` | Run only the API with hot reload (air). |
| `make run` | Run the API once from source. |
| `make serve` | Alias for `run`. |
| `make queue` | Run the queue worker (River). Stop with Ctrl-C. |
| `make schedule` | Run the scheduler daemon. Stop with Ctrl-C. |
| `make test` | Run the unit test suite. |
| `make test-race` | Run the unit test suite with the race detector. |
| `make test-cover` | Run tests and write coverage.html. |
| `make test-integration` | Run the full suite against a real Postgres. |
| `make vet` | Run go vet. |
| `make format` | Format all Go code. |
| `make fmt` | Alias for `format`. |
| `make format-check` | Fail when any Go file is not gofmt-clean. |
| `make fmt-check` | Alias for `format-check`. |
| `make lint` | Run golangci-lint. |
| `make lint-fix` | Run golangci-lint and apply automatic fixes. |
| `make tidy` | Tidy go.mod and go.sum. |
| `make check` | Format check + vet + lint + unit tests. |
| `make sqlc` | Regenerate sqlc output in internal/dbgen. |
| `make openapi` | Regenerate OpenAPI-derived types in internal/contract. |
| `make openapi-gen` | Refresh the generated regions of api/openapi.yaml from module routes/DTOs. |
| `make openapi-check` | Validate the spec + route drift and fail if the generated regions are stale. |
| `make generate` | Regenerate all generated code. |
| `make gen-check` | Verify generated code, docs and skill copies are current; fails on drift. |
| `make skills-sync` | Copy the agent skills (.agents/skills, canonical) to .claude/skills for Claude Code. |
| `make skills-check` | Fail when .claude/skills differs from .agents/skills (run `make skills-sync`). |
| `make docs` | Preview the documentation site with hot reload at http://localhost:4321. |
| `make docs-build` | Build the documentation site into docsite/dist and check every link. |
| `make docs-gen` | Regenerate docs/reference (CLI, configuration, permissions, make) from the code. |
| `make db-up` | Start the local Postgres via docker compose. |
| `make db-down` | Stop the local Postgres. |
| `make migrate` | Apply pending migrations. |
| `make migrate-status` | Show applied and pending migrations. |
| `make migrate-rollback` | Roll back the most recent migration. |
| `make seed` | Seed permissions, default tenant/branch/roles, super-admin and developer users. |
| `make fresh` | Roll back everything, migrate and seed. Destructive. |
| `make health` | Run the application health checks. |
| `make config` | Print the effective configuration with secrets masked. |
| `make version` | Print the build version. |
| `make clean` | Remove build artifacts. |
| `make clean-all` | Also remove local runtime state. |
